visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot features a bright green slushie in a transparent glass, with several whole green onions protruding vertically like straws. The background shows a blurred kitchen setting with bright indoor lighting reflecting off the glass surface. No text overlays are present in this initial frame. (2) A man with short black hair, wearing a plain white t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit kitchen. He gestures excitedly towards a silver and black NINJA Sluski machine on the counter. His mouth is open in a wide smile, and his eyes are expressive and engaging. (3) The camera captures a medium close-up of the man as he leans forward to take a large, dramatic bite of the green onion slushie. His facial muscles tensed as he reacts to the cold temperature, and he looks directly into the lens with a surprised expression. (4) A series of instructional close-up shots show the man pouring green liquid and white powder from various containers into the machine's clear reservoir. Each action is precise, and the liquid's vibrant color contrasts sharply with the metallic parts of the kitchen equipment behind it. (5) The man's finger presses a glowing button on the machine's control panel, which features several labeled modes. Inside the transparent container, a blue plastic auger begins to rotate slowly, churning the green liquid as it gradually transforms into a thick, frozen slushie texture. (6) In a smooth motion, the man dispenses the frozen green mixture into a tall glass. The slushie flows out in a consistent, soft-serve-like ribbon, looking remarkably fine-grained and dense. His hands are steady as he manages the lever on the machine's front. (7) A young boy wearing a yellow and red polo shirt enters the frame. Together with the man, he carefully places multiple green onions into the slushie glass. The boy's movements are concentrated, and he smiles as he interacts with the man in the kitchen environment. (8) The man uses a silver spoon to feed a portion of the green slushie to the boy. The boy's eyes widen as he tastes it, followed by a vigorous nod and a bright smile. The kitchen background remains consistent, showing well-organized cabinets and countertop items. (9) The scene shifts to the preparation of a second beverage. The man pours pink strawberry milk and thick white cream into the clean machine reservoir. The pouring is shown in a high-angle close-up, highlighting the viscous textures of the ingredients as they blend together. (10) The resulting pink strawberry slushie is poured into a clean glass. The man then meticulously garnishes the top with freshly chopped red strawberry pieces and shakes a green seasoning bottle, sprinkling black pepper over the cold dessert. His focus is entirely on the presentation. (11) The man and the boy share the strawberry slushie, taking turns with spoons. The man's reaction is extremely positive, with him leaning back and laughing. The lighting remains bright and even, emphasizing the vibrant colors of the food and the cheerful domestic atmosphere. (12) Standing next to the machine, the man points his index finger toward the camera while speaking. He maintains high energy and a direct gaze at the viewer, acting as a presenter. The video concludes with a wide shot of the two slushies and the machine.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這款“鹹蔥冰沙”你喝過嗎！！ [Variety]: 尖叫聲!!. (2) [Slogan]: 新上市 NINJA Sluski 冰沙機來做. [Variety]: 哇~!. (3) [Variety]: 還要吃~. (4) [Subtitle]: 鹹蔥檸檬冰沙 (1500ml). 材料: 新鮮蔥段:150g. 檸檬汁:90ml. 冷開水:1220ml. 砂糖:75g. 鹽:2-2.5g. (5) [Subtitle]: 只要把飲料倒進去. 不需要加冰塊. (6) [Subtitle]: 再按一個按鍵. 點擊“冰沙模式”. (7) [Subtitle]: 製作時間只要40分鐘. 很快就可以完成了. (8) [Subtitle]: 而且保冰時間可以維持12小時. 沒馬上喝也沒關係!!. (9) [Variety]: WOO~~. 很綿密的感覺欸. (10) [Variety]: 裝飾中. 換爸爸插. 整把插入. (11) [Subtitle]: 就是要這麼衝擊的一個感覺. 咸蔥檸檬冰沙 完成!!. (12) [Subtitle]: 來青蔥. 相當衝擊的一個味道. (13) [Subtitle]: 配個豬肉一定會非常的搭配 (豬肉配冰沙??). 小朋友吃這個不會辣哦. (14) [Variety]: (點頭) (好可愛). (15) [Subtitle]: 而且它口感完全沒有碎冰的感覺. 非常滑順. (16) [Subtitle]: 草莓黑胡椒奶昔 (1500ml). 奶昔模式. (17) [Variety]: 還滿安靜的. (18) [Subtitle]: 製作時間只要大概50分鐘. (19) [Variety]: (請忽略發音) strawberry. 草莓擺盤中. 再撒點黑胡椒. (20) [Subtitle]: 草莓黑胡椒奶昔 完成!!.
